structure: CSharp InferBranchExpression infers the complete source value, then rejects owned source types not supported by recursive IsParallelSharedTypeSupported before inspecting arms. Both ordinary and readonly input names materialize the underlying value type. Native firstParallelBranchDiagnostic has no corresponding source owner/shareability guard.
branches: Arena, nominal/nested Arena owners, materialized readonly Arena, Copy struct, structurally safe owned array struct, and immutable SourceText. Preserve exact rejection before LLVM and safe outputs.
logic: Compare source ownership using the existing canonical typeContainsOwnedStorageWithFields. Reuse one structural shareability walk for source and capture facts rather than copying the capture classifier. Source AST comes from the existing canonical flow-source index of the parent flow, not an arm target or descendant scalar.
diagnostics: Four CSharp source rejections precede arm decisions; three safe runtime cases succeed. Initial probe assumed readonly Arena would bypass ownership; actual materialized-read contract rejects it and that observed behavior is retained.
sharedPolicyDecision: CSharp ParallelBranchSourceAllowed owns the actual ownership/shareability Boolean decision, exported by the existing compiled policy generator. Reuse one canonical structural value classifier for source and capture facts. Materialize the source read type first and report source rejection before arm mode or target diagnostics.
familySourceDecision: CSharp GetOrAddProduct registers products as structs, so their committed fields participate in recursive sharing. Heap/Deque register dynamic-array storage and Set registers dictionary storage. Task/Stream/EventStream are not any supported IsValueTypeSupported family. Arguments is not a supported capture leaf, even though its non-owning source is admitted by the shared source predicate.
taskSourceDecision: Production Native24 writes a Task capture ABI but its nominal capture typeId still projects the Int payload. Plain ownership CLI therefore reports0 using provisional payload types. Reuse the existing typedIr.isTaskOwnerValue predicate and its AST propagation used by taskFlowContract; classify both payload type and Task-owner fact, and render Task<payload> for that split representation. Do not invent a source-name exception, change the async value model or double-wrap Task identities. Awaited payloads must retain their ordinary value contract.
